items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: A vertically stacked set of headers that expand and collapse their panels, revealing one section of content at a time.

items.name: ai-chat-composer
items.title: AI Chat Composer
items.description: A message composer for AI chats: one row with actions around the text that opens into a column once the text wraps or attachments are added, with an expand action and a send button.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: A callout that surfaces important contextual information — such as a status update or a failure — without interrupting the user's flow.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: A modal confirmation dialog that interrupts the user before a destructive or irreversible action is carried out.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect Ratio
items.description: Constrains its content to a fixed width-to-height ratio so media, embeds, and placeholders keep their shape at any container size.

items.name: attachment
items.title: Attachment
items.description: An uploaded or in-flight file as a picture, a card that names its type or a row (full or compact) with its icon, name and metadata, with its upload state and actions.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Displays a user's image with an automatic initials fallback, plus optional status badge and stacked group with overflow count.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A small inline label for surfacing statuses, categories, and metadata next to other content.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Displays the path to the current page as a hierarchy of links so users can see where they are and jump back to any parent level.

items.name: bubble
items.title: Bubble
items.description: A chat message bubble for conversation UIs, with sender alignment, tonal variants, grouped messages, and emoji reactions.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Triggers an action. Six emphasis levels, five sizes with icon-only counterparts and an optional count chip.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button Group
items.description: Groups related buttons and controls into a single connected segment with shared borders and rounded outer corners.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A month grid for picking a single date, multiple dates, or a date range, built on react-day-picker.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: An opaque surface that groups related content, with slots for a header, title, description, action, content, and footer.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: A slide container for cycling through related content, built on Embla with previous/next buttons and arrow-key navigation.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: Recharts-based building blocks — a themed container, tooltip, and legend that pull series labels and colors from a single chart config.

items.name: chat-sidebar-01
items.title: Chat Sidebar
items.description: Chat history in a sidebar: new chat with its shortcut, search, conversations grouped by date with pinning, per-chat actions on hover and the account menu.

items.name: chat-thread-01
items.title: Chat Thread
items.description: A conversation with an assistant: your messages and attachments on the right, answers across the full width with folded reasoning, lists and bold text, copy / feedback / share / retry actions, and a thinking state.

items.name: chat-welcome-01
items.title: Chat Welcome
items.description: The empty state of a new chat: a greeting, the prompt input and suggestion buttons that start a conversation in one click.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A control that lets the user toggle a single option between checked and unchecked states.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: A panel that expands and collapses to reveal or hide secondary content behind a trigger.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: An input that filters a list of options as the user types and lets them pick a value from a popup.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: A searchable command menu for finding and running actions, with grouped, keyboard-navigable results and built-in filtering.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: A menu of contextual actions that opens at the pointer position when the user right-clicks (or long-presses) a target element.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal window over the page content. Composed from focused subcomponents.

items.name: diff
items.title: Diff
items.description: Shows the changes to a file as a unified or split diff — line numbers, added and removed lines, +/- counts in the header and syntax highlighting — from a patch or from two versions of the file.

items.name: direction
items.title: Direction
items.description: A context provider that switches Base UI components between left-to-right and right-to-left reading directions.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A panel that slides in from an edge of the screen and can be swiped away, for supplementary content and quick actions.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: A menu of actions or options that opens from a trigger element, with support for groups, submenus, checkbox and radio items.

items.name: effort-slider-01
items.title: Effort Slider
items.description: A model-effort picker: a stepped slider whose thumb is pulled toward the nearest level and springs onto it, with a cross-fading level name, a recommended mark and a pixel field that lights the track at the top level.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: A placeholder state for screens with no data yet, combining an icon, a title, a description, and follow-up actions.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Composable building blocks for form fields — label, description, error, and layout primitives that wrap any control.

items.name: file-icon
items.title: File Icon
items.description: A coloured icon for each kind of file — document, spreadsheet, presentation, PDF, image, video, music, archive or a plain file — sized like a Lucide icon in attachments and lists.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: A card that previews linked content, such as a user or project, when the pointer rests on its trigger.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A single-line text field. Three heights that line up with Button.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: Groups an input or textarea with icons, text, buttons, and keyboard hints inside a single field container.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input OTP
items.description: A one-time password input with individual character slots, caret animation, and paste support for verification codes.

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: A composable list row that arranges media, text content, and actions into a single flexible container.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Displays a keyboard key or key combination, used for surfacing shortcut hints in menus, tooltips, and documentation.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: An accessible caption for a form control, associated via htmlFor and styled to dim automatically when its control is disabled.

items.name: marker
items.title: Marker
items.description: A muted inline label row with an optional icon for annotating lists, feeds, and timelines — usable as a plain note, a centered separator, or a bordered section heading.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: A horizontal bar of persistent dropdown menus, like the command menus along the top of a desktop application.

items.name: message
items.title: Message
items.description: A layout wrapper for chat threads that positions an avatar, message bubbles, a sender header, and a timestamp footer, with start or end alignment per message.

items.name: message-scroller
items.title: Message Scroller
items.description: A scroll container for chat and feed interfaces that starts at the latest message, keeps its position while history changes, and shows a button to jump back to the newest content.

items.name: model-picker-01
items.title: Model Picker
items.description: A header menu for choosing the model a chat runs on — each option with a one-line description and a Pro badge — plus an upgrade entry.

items.name: native-select
items.title: Native Select
items.description: A styled wrapper around the browser's built-in select element for compact, dependency-free option pickers that use the platform's native dropdown UI.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation Menu
items.description: A horizontal menu of links and animated dropdown panels for top-level site or product navigation.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Navigation between pages of a long list, with previous/next controls, numbered page links, and an ellipsis for collapsed ranges.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A floating panel anchored to a trigger element, for lightweight details and actions that don't need a full dialog.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Displays a bar or circular ring that shows how far a task or quota has progressed toward completion, with optional label and value text.

items.name: prompt-input-01
items.title: Prompt Input
items.description: A chat composer: a growing message field, file attachments with previews, a tools menu (web search, deep research, image), and a send button that turns into stop while the answer streams.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: A set of mutually exclusive options where selecting one choice deselects the others.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Resizable panel groups with draggable, keyboard-accessible handles for building split views and adjustable layouts.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: A scrollable region with a custom, consistently styled scrollbar that replaces the native one across browsers and platforms.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A dropdown control for picking one option from a list, opened from a trigger button and submitted like a native form field.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A thin rule that visually and semantically divides content, either horizontally between sections or vertically between inline items.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A panel that slides in from an edge of the screen to show supplementary content or actions without leaving the current page.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: A composable side navigation panel with collapsible, floating, and inset modes for building application layouts.

items.name: simple-icon
items.title: Simple Icon
items.description: Renders a brand icon from Simple Icons — GitHub, Apple, Google, Figma — as a currentColor svg that sizes like a Lucide icon inside buttons and text.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A pulsing placeholder that reserves the shape of content while it loads.

items.name: sleep-widget-01
items.title: Sleep Widget
items.description: Last night's sleep: the stages along a usage bar with a time axis, the totals per stage, a smart alarm switch and a wake-window slider.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A draggable control for selecting a numeric value or range within fixed bounds.

items.name: sonner
items.title: Sonner
items.description: An opinionated toast component for showing brief, stackable notifications — successes, errors, and undoable actions — from anywhere in your app.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: An animated loading indicator for pending actions and in-flight state.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: A toggle control for switching a single setting on or off instantly.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: A styled HTML table for presenting structured data in rows and columns, with header, body, footer, and caption parts and a built-in horizontal-scroll container.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: A set of layered panels where selecting a tab in the list shows its panel and hides the others.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A multi-line text field for longer free-form input such as notes, descriptions, and messages, with content-based auto-sizing.

items.name: theme
items.title: SortUI theme
items.description: The SortUI tokens v2 as one theme: opaque surfaces with a dark ladder (card 900, popover 800), the translucent fill ladder fill-1…4, the roles field / raised / control, translucent lines (border, field-border, control-border), AA text colours (muted-foreground neutral-550, destructive-foreground red-700) and the fixed radius ladder. Installs over your theme variables.
items.docs: SortUI theme installed — your :root and .dark variables now carry the SortUI values (tokens v2), and @theme inline maps the SortUI colours and the fixed radius ladder. Components from @sortui ship the SortUI tokens they use on their own; this theme sets the base values they are designed with. Fonts are not part of the theme: SortUI is set in Inter, with headings in the sans font.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A two-state button for switching an option on or off, such as view or formatting settings in a toolbar.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: A set of two-state buttons that share one selection state, allowing either a single pressed item or several at once.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A small floating label that reveals extra context for a control when it is hovered or focused.

items.name: trace
items.title: AI Trace
items.description: Lines of agent activity — reasoning, tool calls, searches, sources, plans and subagent runs — each with an icon, a title and an optional description and status, expandable into nested detail.

items.name: usage-bar
items.title: Usage Bar
items.description: Shows how a whole is shared out — storage, a data plan, a quota — as one row of segments sized by their value, with a legend, an axis and a highlighted segment that a list beside it can follow.

items.name: use-mobile
items.title: useMobile
items.description: React hook that tracks whether the viewport is below the mobile breakpoint (768px).

items.name: utils
items.title: Utils
items.description: The cn() class-merge helper used by every component.
